# NucleoOS shell reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_shell_doc.py from components/nv_apps/term_sh.cpp. Do not edit. -->

The Terminal app runs a small POSIX-flavoured shell with GNU-style core utilities. Open it on the
device, or from the web desktop. `help` lists the commands, and `help CMD` or `CMD --help` prints
the usage line for one of them.

## Differences from bash (read this first)

Supported: `'single'` and `"double"` quotes, `\` escapes, `$VAR`, `${VAR}`, `$?`, `~`, globs
(`* ? [..]`), pipes `|`, redirections `> >> < 2> 2>&1` and `/dev/null`, lists `; && ||`, `#` comments,
`NAME=value`, `export`, `unset`.

Not supported: command substitution (`$(...)` and backticks), `if`/`for`/`while`/`case`, functions,
script files (`sh file`, `source`), background jobs (`&`), here-documents, arithmetic `$((...))`,
symbolic links, users and permissions. Use `xargs` instead of loops, for example
`find /sdcard -name '*.txt' | xargs -I F wc -l F`.

- Paths: `/` is a virtual directory listing the volumes (`/sdcard`, `/usb0`..`/usb6`). The home
  directory is `~`.
- Pipes run one stage after another through memory, with a 1 MB cap on each stage's output.
- Option support is a subset: the usage lines below list every flag each command accepts.
- A name that is not a built-in runs the installed terminal program of that name (`lua`, `sqlite3`,
  `js`, ...). `apps` lists them. Graphical apps open from Home, not from the shell.

## Commands

| Command | Usage | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `[` | `[ EXPRESSION ]` | evaluate a condition (like test) |
| `apps` | `apps` | list installed terminal programs |
| `awk` | `awk [-F SEP] [-v N=V] 'PROGRAM' [FILE...]` | pattern scanning (subset) |
| `base64` | `base64 [-d] [-w COLS] [FILE]` | base64 encode / decode |
| `basename` | `basename NAME [SUFFIX]` | strip directory and suffix |
| `bl` | `bl 0-100` | set the backlight |
| `cat` | `cat [-n] [FILE...]` | print files |
| `cd` | `cd [DIR\|-]` | change directory |
| `clear` | `clear` | clear the screen |
| `command` | `command -v NAME...` | print how a name would run |
| `cp` | `cp [-rnv] SRC... DEST` | copy files and directories |
| `curl` | `curl [-sLfO] [-o FILE] URL` | transfer a URL (HTTP/HTTPS) |
| `cut` | `cut -f LIST [-d C] [-s] \| -c LIST [FILE...]` | select fields or characters |
| `date` | `date [+FORMAT]` | print the date and time |
| `df` | `df [-h]` | free space on each volume |
| `dirname` | `dirname NAME` | strip the last path component |
| `dmesg` | `dmesg` | kernel log |
| `du` | `du [-shc] [PATH...]` | disk usage |
| `echo` | `echo [-ne] [TEXT...]` | print text |
| `edit` | `edit [FILE]` | text editor (nano keys: ^S save, ^X exit) |
| `env` | `env` | print the environment |
| `exit` | `exit` | close the terminal |
| `export` | `export NAME=VALUE...` | set variables |
| `expr` | `expr EXPRESSION` | evaluate an expression |
| `false` | `false` | exit with status 1 |
| `find` | `find [PATH...] [-name\|-iname PAT] [-type f\|d] [-maxdepth N] [-mindepth N] [-size [+-]N[ckMG]] [-mtime\|-mmin [+-]N] [-newer F] [-empty]` | search for files |
| `free` | `free [-hkm]` | memory usage |
| `grep` | `grep [-ivnclrFqHhow] [-e] PATTERN [FILE...]` | print lines matching a pattern |
| `head` | `head [-n N\|-c N] [FILE...]` | first lines |
| `help` | `help [COMMAND]` | list commands / show usage |
| `history` | `history [-c]` | command history |
| `host` | `host NAME` | DNS lookup |
| `hostname` | `hostname [-I]` | print the host name |
| `i2cdetect` | `i2cdetect` | scan the I2C bus |
| `id` | `id` | user and group ids |
| `ip` | `ip` | network address and link |
| `less` | `less [FILE]` | page through text (q quits, / searches) |
| `ls` | `ls [-laAhtSr1dF] [PATH...]` | list directory contents |
| `man` | `man COMMAND` | show usage |
| `md5sum` | `md5sum [FILE...]` | MD5 checksums |
| `mkdir` | `mkdir [-pv] DIR...` | make directories |
| `mv` | `mv [-nv] SRC... DEST` | move or rename |
| `nl` | `nl [-b a] [FILE...]` | number lines |
| `nproc` | `nproc` | number of CPU cores |
| `open` | `open FILE` | open a file in its app |
| `ping` | `ping [-c COUNT] HOST` | send ICMP echo requests |
| `printf` | `printf FORMAT [ARG...]` | formatted output |
| `ps` | `ps` | system services |
| `pwd` | `pwd` | print the working directory |
| `realpath` | `realpath PATH...` | absolute path |
| `reboot` | `reboot` | restart the device |
| `reset` | `reset` | reset the terminal |
| `rev` | `rev [FILE...]` | reverse each line |
| `rm` | `rm [-rfv] FILE...` | remove files or directories |
| `rmdir` | `rmdir DIR...` | remove empty directories |
| `sed` | `sed [-n] [-i] [-e SCRIPT] SCRIPT [FILE...]` | stream editor (s d p q =) |
| `sensors` | `sensors` | chip temperature |
| `seq` | `seq [-s SEP] [-w] [FIRST [INC]] LAST` | print a sequence of numbers |
| `sha1sum` | `sha1sum [FILE...]` | SHA-1 checksums |
| `sha256sum` | `sha256sum [FILE...]` | SHA-256 checksums |
| `sleep` | `sleep SECONDS` | wait |
| `sort` | `sort [-rnufh] [-k K[,E]] [-t SEP] [FILE...]` | sort lines |
| `stat` | `stat [-c FORMAT] FILE...` | file status |
| `stty` | `stty [size]` | terminal settings |
| `tac` | `tac [FILE...]` | print lines in reverse order |
| `tail` | `tail [-n N\|+N] [-c N] [FILE...]` | last lines |
| `tee` | `tee [-a] [FILE...]` | copy stdin to files and stdout |
| `test` | `test EXPRESSION` | evaluate a condition |
| `time` | `time [-p] COMMAND [ARG...]` | time a command (wall clock) |
| `top` | `top [-b] [-n N] [-d SECONDS]` | live task and CPU view |
| `touch` | `touch FILE...` | create a file / update its time |
| `tr` | `tr [-dsc] SET1 [SET2]` | translate or delete characters |
| `tree` | `tree [-ad] [-L N] [DIR]` | directory tree |
| `true` | `true` | exit with status 0 |
| `type` | `type NAME...` | how a name would be run |
| `uname` | `uname [-asnrmo]` | system information |
| `update` | `update [status\|check\|install\|sd [FILE]\|restart]` | firmware updates (Settings > Update) |
| `uniq` | `uniq [-cdi] [FILE...]` | drop repeated lines |
| `unset` | `unset NAME...` | remove variables |
| `uptime` | `uptime` | time since boot |
| `usb` | `usb [host\|device]` | USB port mode |
| `watch` | `watch [-n SECONDS] [-t] COMMAND [ARG...]` | run a command repeatedly |
| `wc` | `wc [-lwc] [FILE...]` | count lines, words, bytes |
| `wget` | `wget [-q] [-O FILE] URL` | download a file |
| `which` | `which NAME...` | locate a command |
| `whoami` | `whoami` | print the user name |
| `xargs` | `xargs [-n N] [-I R] [-0] [-d C] [-t] [-r] [COMMAND...]` | build commands from stdin |
| `xxd` | `xxd [-l N] [FILE]` | hex dump |

## Aliases

`cls` = `clear`, `dir` = `ls`, `ll` = `ls`, `log` = `dmesg`, `temp` = `sensors`, `ifconfig` = `ip`, `wifi` = `ip`, `mem` = `free`, `i2c` = `i2cdetect`, `ver` = `uname`, `version` = `uname`, `services` = `ps`, `hexdump` = `xxd`, `programs` = `apps`, `xdg-open` = `open`, `logout` = `exit`, `printenv` = `env`, `set` = `env`, `restart` = `reboot`, `nslookup` = `host`, `htop` = `top`, `readlink` = `realpath`, `egrep` = `grep`, `gawk` = `awk`, `nano` = `edit`, `more` = `less`, `pico` = `edit`
